transitionMatrix.predecessor: before-state and invocation high-water; no ledger predecessor created by this change
transitionMatrix.nextState: unfinished cards retry in original order only after progress; already completed later cards are skipped before invoking; no-progress otherwise
transitionMatrix.persistentEffects: existing audit event only; fixture producer conclusion changes isolated tracker state; no production tracker mutation by list driver
transitionMatrix.immutableFields: input order, card association and authoritative review signal ownership; unchanged historical contracts and active risk identity
transitionMatrix.forbidden: unrelated mentions buying retries; native vote requirement masking Pair progress; stale completed-card snapshot dispatch; partial/adverse review evidence advancing; terminal/human state bypass
transitionMatrix.refusal: existing no-progress / terminal / pass-cap report and exit 1; no new typed ledger refusal
transitionMatrix.replayRetryRestart: T-replay, T-high-water, T-cap, L-interaction and D-later; no fresh progress from identical evidence or regression/recovery
transitionMatrix.terminalPreconditions: actual current card completion before invocation, plus existing terminal result precedence after invocation
transitionMatrix.metricEffects: No new metrics; existing report/audit/exit consumers checked by the listed rows
